_comment: MU Linux 0.97k Web Pterodactyl egg. Import in a PTDL_v2 Panel.
name: MU Linux 0.97k Web
author: support@mu-linux.com
description: MU Linux web panel. The installer downloads web files into the server volume and installs production Node.js dependencies there.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
REPOSITORY=EmanuelCatania/Mu-Linux
ASSET=mu-linux-97k-web.tar.gz
URL=https://github.com/${REPOSITORY}/releases/download/${MU_RELEASE_TAG}/${ASSET}
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo "Downloading ${ASSET} from ${MU_RELEASE_TAG}..."
curl --fail --location --retry 3 "${URL}" -o /tmp/mu-web.tar.gz
tar -xzf /tmp/mu-web.tar.gz -C /mnt/server
rm /tmp/mu-web.tar.gz
cd /mnt/server
npm ci --omit=dev
echo "MU Linux 0.97k web panel installed."

variables.name: Release tag
variables.description: GitHub release to install. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Web port
variables.description: Managed from the primary Pterodactyl allocation.

variables.name: Session secret
variables.description: Use a unique secret with at least 32 characters.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: Initial administrator password. The application requires changing it after first sign-in.

variables.name: Trust proxy
variables.description: Enable when the panel is behind a reverse proxy.
